A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same position paper. Their complete main texts and appendices are readable, and corresponding sections, equations, figures and result tables can be matched despite reorganization.

before.justification: Section 4.1 explicitly reports the authors' replication of Şahinüç et al. (2024). Footnote 15 gives recall of 47.53 with per-paper averaging versus 34.92 with global averaging, constituting an original empirical reanalysis.

after.justification: Section 4.1 and footnote 16 retain the same author-performed replication and numerical findings. These qualify despite the added general statement in Limitations that the paper contains no new experiments.

M1.justification: The four-stage conceptual framework in Section 5 and Figure 2 remains unchanged. Multimodal inputs are suggested for future research, while caching and database recommendations elaborate implementation guidance without introducing a replacement extraction algorithm or model.

E1.justification: The reported evaluations retain the same datasets, extraction tasks and domain scenarios. Figure 1 uses a different illustrative leaderboard, but this does not add training or evaluation coverage; multimodal processing remains a proposed direction.

E2.justification: Matching v1 Table 7 against v2 Tables 8–15 shows unchanged comparison-method membership, including String Match, Multi-Label Classification, Entity Linking and AxCell. Newly cited work is not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Reported splits, sample sizes, model configurations, document representations and evaluation metrics are retained. Dataset-versioning and scalability recommendations do not revise the settings of the existing replication or compiled experiments.

E4.justification: The metric-averaging demonstration and previously compiled document-representation ablations remain unchanged. Splitting the appendix results into separate tables adds no ablation, robustness test, error analysis or evaluated case study.

E5.justification: Existing cross-validation and averaging disclosures are retained, including the two-fold cross-validation note in the detailed dataset table. No new run-count, seed, confidence-interval or significance reporting appears.

E6.justification: Figure 1 replaces illustrative SQuAD 2.0 F1 results of 89.2 and 87.6 with SQuAD exact-match results of 40.0 for RAG E2E and 24.1 for DPR. These are different cited examples, not comparable performance changes. The replication findings and compiled ALG evaluation scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The PTE/PTT definitions and all six metric equations are retained. The metric appendix moves from Appendix E to F without substantive mathematical changes; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same four contributions: an ALG overview, unified conceptual framework, benchmarking guidelines, and research directions advocating broader result and metadata coverage.

C2.justification: v2 adds reasoning about preserving visual layout through multimodal inputs and explicitly recommends dataset versioning based on the existing SciREX discrepancy. Section 5.3 softens the characterization of NLI from verification to providing a rationale, and Limitations adds a qualification about the absence of new experiments.

D1.justification: Sections 5.2.2 and 5.4 make implementation guidance more concrete by specifying cached entity/tuple mappings, batched database writes, schema-aware indexing and hash-based deduplication. These are recommendations, not evidence of changed experimental implementations. Existing settings and repository access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds MatViX to motivate multimodal extraction and expands related work with scientific knowledge graphs, research-trend analysis, numerical extraction and contribution-statement extraction. Figure 1 also replaces its supporting references. These broaden contextual coverage without changing the central novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds an acronym appendix, localized explanatory paragraphs and wording corrections while retaining the main section sequence and most prose. Author order, affiliation wording and the ethics statement are also edited; the document is not extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: The long results table in v1 is reorganized into eight separately captioned tables in v2, with extraction-target-specific presentation and local explanatory notes. Figure 1 is redrawn with a method column, an acronym table is added, and Figure 2 is relocated. This substantially changes visual organization while preserving the appendix result entries.

improvement.justification: The acronym glossary and separately captioned results tables improve navigation, while expanded related work and concrete scalability/versioning guidance increase usefulness. The central framework and empirical evidence remain unchanged. The added statement about no new experiments is ambiguous alongside the retained replication, but the overall gains in clarity and accessibility support a modest improvement.
